Keepin It Reel by Oversee 30A | Perfect in Walton County Awards – Three-Time Diamond Winner – Best Rental Mgmt. 2026, 2025, 2024 Welcome to Keepin’ It Reel, a stylish 4-bedroom, 4.5-bathroom retreat in the heart of Seagrove Beach. This brand-new, modern home provides a fun combination of modern luxury, Southern charm, and a perfect setting for your 30A escape. Your private backyard is a true oasis, featuring a sparkling pool, a relaxing spa, and comfy lounge chairs to unwind. With a seating area, TV, and gas grill, it’s set up perfectly for casual outdoor gatherings on warm Florida nights. Inside, the open living and dining space feels both elegant and inviting, with chic décor and airy marble floors. The living room offers plenty of seating and opens right up to the pool area, creating a seamless flow between indoor and outdoor living! For cooking enthusiasts, the gourmet kitchen is a dream, outfitted with high-end appliances that make every meal feel like a special occasion. The first-floor primary suite has a king bed, en-suite bath, and direct pool access—offering the ultimate in privacy and convenience. Upstairs, three additional bedrooms, each with their own private bath, provide plenty of space and comfort.

A cozy landing area adds a perfect spot for relaxing. You’ll be close to Seagrove’s amazing beaches, fantastic dining, and unique local shops, and Seaside is just a short bike ride away. Let this luxurious home, with its incredible amenities, be the hub of your next unforgettable 30A getaway. Welcome! Our dedicated team at Oversee 30A, a local company, is committed to ensuring your stay is nothing short of exceptional. We strive for perfection and are just a stone's throw away should you require any assistance. Reach out to us anytime, seven days a week, with the added peace of a 24/7 emergency line. Overview: - 4 bedrooms, 4.5 baths - Private pool with spillover spa (pool can be heated seasonally for $55/day, contact Oversee for details) - 2,958 sq. ft. - Six-seater golf cart - 4 bikes included - Gas grill - High-speed Wi-Fi Overnight: FIRST FLOOR - Primary bedroom: King bed, private bath, TV, direct pool access SECOND FLOOR - Guest bedroom: King bed, private bath, TV - Guest bedroom: Two queen beds, private bath, TV - Guest bedroom: Two twin beds, private bath, TV Check-in: 4:00 PM CST Checkout: 10:00 AM CST
